en-US.title: UniPrep
en-US.subtitle: Practice tests & AI tutor
en-US.description:
UniPrep is your all-in-one study companion for university. Pick your university and major, and get a full study toolkit for every subject you take.

PRACTICE QUESTIONS
Every subject comes with practice questions at three difficulty levels — easy, medium and hard. Answer multiple-choice questions and get instant feedback on each one: what you got right, where you went wrong, and a full explanation so the concept sticks.

PAST EXAM-STYLE TESTS
Work through open-ended test papers written in your university's exam style. Write your answers, and AI grades each one — with your score, what you did right, what you missed, and a model answer. If your university has no material for a subject, UniPrep shows which top universities share tests for it, so you can still practice with comparable material.

AI TOPICS, EXPLAINED SIMPLY
Each subject covers its topics with AI-written study guides — a clear summary, key points to remember, and worked examples. It is like having a tutor break the material down before you start.

ASK AI ANYTHING
Curious how many credits a subject is worth? Wondering how hard the final is, or how the course is structured? Ask the AI assistant in plain language and get answers about the subject instantly.

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
Add your classes to a clean weekly calendar — pick the days, times, room and color — and see your schedule laid out like a proper calendar app. Today's classes show right on your home screen.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Finish a practice test and see a predicted score with detailed tips on what to study next and how to improve. Jump back into recent subjects with one tap.

Whether you are starting a new semester, preparing for finals, or just want to understand a subject better, UniPrep gives you the practice, the explanations and the plan.

Note: study material is generated by AI and modeled on each university's style — always double-check credits and requirements with your university's official catalog.
en-US.promoText: Practice tests, AI-written study guides and instant feedback — for every subject at your university.

en-US.title: UniPrep
en-US.shortDescription: University study app with practice tests, AI study guides and instant feedback
en-US.fullDescription:
UniPrep is a university study companion that gives every student a full toolkit for each subject they take. Choose your university and major, then explore every subject from A to Z with search built in.

Practice questions in three difficulty levels. Each subject includes easy, medium and hard multiple-choice practice sets. Every answer comes with instant feedback: what you did right, what you did wrong, and a full explanation of the concept.

Exam-style past tests with AI grading. Work through open-ended test papers modeled on your university's exam style. Submit your written answers and receive a score for each one, a breakdown of what you got right and wrong, and a model answer to compare against. If your university has no material for a subject, UniPrep shows which top universities share comparable tests so you can keep practicing.

AI-written study guides for every topic. Each topic comes with a clear summary, the key points to remember, and a worked example, so the material is easier to understand before you start solving problems.

Ask AI anything about a subject. Want to know how many credits a course is worth, how the exam is structured, or what topics it covers? Ask in plain language and get an answer in seconds.

A weekly class calendar. Add your subjects to a clean weekly schedule with days, times, rooms and colors, laid out like the calendar app you already know. Today's classes appear on your home screen so your day is always visible at a glance.

Score prediction and study tips. Finish a practice test and get a predicted score plus detailed, personalized tips on which topics to study and how to improve before the real exam.

Track your progress. Your best scores show next to each difficulty level, and recently opened subjects are one tap away so you can jump straight back into studying.

Note: study material is generated by AI and modeled on each university's style. Always verify credits and course requirements with your university's official catalog.
